body: Merge seat FYI: recording a request-changes verdict (aida review record) automatically places a rework merge-hold, and 'aida merge-hold clear' refuses unless a human is at an interactive terminal. Advisor authority can't override it. Effect tonight: #2583 (BUG-1930) is approved at 55e32d5ea0 with green CI but held (marker PR-2583). #2588 (TASK-1736, in round-2 rework) will hit the same hold, which also blocks #2587. #2586 is held too. The operator needs to run 'aida merge-hold clear <pr>' for each approved PR. Merged so far: #2585, #2577, #2589.
subject: merge seat: rework holds need a human to clear
